title: Iron Curtain Call

lyrics:
[Intro]
(Spoken) Lights out. Doors locked.

[Verse]
Concrete heartbeat under my feet
Shadows marching down the street
Nobody leaves till the music's done
Nobody sleeps till we've all gone numb

[Chorus]
Iron curtain call
Watch the empire fall
Iron curtain call
Bodies on the wall

[Bridge]
(Spoken) Encore. Encore.
One more time, then no more
